info.description: Site-wide settings: logo, contact details, social links, SEO defaults, and experience feature flags.

content-manager.label: Site Name
content-manager.description: Official site name shown in browser tabs and SEO (e.g. "The Wolverine Hub").

content-manager.label: Brand Tagline
content-manager.description: Short tagline shown under the logo in some layouts.

content-manager.label: Logo – Light Version
content-manager.description: Full logo for use on dark backgrounds (transparent PNG or SVG).

content-manager.label: Logo – Dark Version
content-manager.description: Full logo for use on light backgrounds (transparent PNG or SVG).

content-manager.label: Logo – Monogram / Icon
content-manager.description: Small square icon version of the logo used in the mobile header and favicons.

content-manager.label: Favicon
content-manager.description: Browser tab icon. Recommended: 32 × 32 px ICO or PNG.

content-manager.label: Contact Email
content-manager.description: Main contact email address displayed on the site.

content-manager.label: Phone Number
content-manager.description: Contact phone number including country code, e.g. +94 77 123 4567.

content-manager.label: WhatsApp Number
content-manager.description: WhatsApp number including country code with no spaces, e.g. +94771234567.

content-manager.label: Physical Address
content-manager.description: Full postal address shown on the Contact page.

content-manager.label: Google Maps URL
content-manager.description: Link to the location on Google Maps.

content-manager.label: Opening Hours (JSON)
content-manager.description: Opening hours as a JSON object, e.g. {"Monday": "6am–9pm", "Tuesday": "6am–9pm"}.

content-manager.label: Instagram Username
content-manager.description: Instagram handle without the @ symbol.

content-manager.label: Facebook Page URL
content-manager.description: Full Facebook page URL.

content-manager.label: YouTube Channel URL
content-manager.description: Full YouTube channel URL.

content-manager.label: TikTok Username
content-manager.description: TikTok handle without the @ symbol.

content-manager.label: Company Registration Number
content-manager.description: Used in legal footer notices.

content-manager.label: Twitter / X Handle
content-manager.description: Twitter/X username without the @ symbol.

content-manager.label: Default SEO Settings
content-manager.description: Fallback SEO used when a page has no specific SEO fields set.

content-manager.label: Enable Intro Animation
content-manager.description: Show the full-screen cinematic intro on first visit.

content-manager.label: Enable WebGL Effects
content-manager.description: Enable 3D / shader effects in the hero section. Disabling improves performance on low-end devices.

content-manager.label: Enable Smooth Scroll
content-manager.description: Enable GSAP ScrollSmoother on desktop browsers.

content-manager.label: Enable Custom Cursor
content-manager.description: Show a custom cursor on desktop (auto-disabled on touch devices).

content-manager.label: Sound On by Default
content-manager.description: Play ambient sound automatically on load. Not recommended — leave off unless specifically needed.

content-manager.label: Motion Intensity
content-manager.description: Full = all animations active. Lite = reduced animations. Minimal = static layout only.
